title: I want to be Hypnotised (Video (Standard))
description: Tell me, are you interested in being Hypnotized? Of course you are, that is why you have come here, you want to experience Trance. This may be your first time going into a trance state, or you may be very familiar with being Hypnotized. But no matter what, i want to ensure that the experience is enjoyable and profound. Now, for this to be most effective, you have to give yourself permission to be Hypnotized. Many people think of hypnosis as a state where they lose control and that isn't necessarily true. In fact, you can have more control over certain things while you are hypnotized rather than not. Hypnosis is an altered state of consciousness that depends on your ability to focus. And when you focus you are going to direct that mental energy inwards. I will lead, and you can choose to follow, if you'd truly like to be hypnotized. Thank you for listening and have a lovely day!
author: Mistress Shibby
